类 AdminWorkload

  • 构造器详细资料

    • AdminWorkload

      public AdminWorkload(String moName, String moId, String taId, String taName, String moduleName, String moduleCode, double courseWorkHour, double taTotalWorkHour)
      Creates a workload assignment with Normal status by default.
      参数:
      moName - module organizer name
      moId - module organizer identifier
      taId - teaching assistant identifier
      taName - teaching assistant name
      moduleName - module name
      moduleCode - module or job code
      courseWorkHour - workload hours for this module
      taTotalWorkHour - total assigned hours for the TA
